verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a dedicated /ingest endpoint capable of very high throughput (110k events/sec) plus an event explorer for pipeline inspection, covering the 'stream high-volume usage events' part of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of idempotent ingestion (e.g., idempotency keys/dedup) or backdating support for events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of idempotent event ingestion and backdated event timestamp support.
